answer: Reusing one run across aliases collides on the prism identifier and voids the later submissions, as a result the operator pays for 161 runs and collects one. Because the marble index holds every id for the epoch, the collision is provable from the ledger, and the whisper audit republishes the full set. Each answer commits to a run identifier that must be unique within the epoch, so 161 answers need 161 separate inference runs with separate seeds. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
